lines.speaker: orphan_elsa
lines.text: Save the quiet voice, Tom. She's not deaf.

lines.speaker: orphan_tom
lines.text: Fine. Mira — get up. Cold bread's still warm if we run.

lines.speaker: mira
lines.text: Five more minutes. The awning's not even warm yet.

lines.speaker: orphan_elsa
lines.text: Then five more. We'll keep your share.

lines.speaker: neighbor_holt
lines.text: Late last night. I couldn't sleep. The dogs wouldn't settle.

lines.speaker: neighbor_holt
lines.text: A tall man, not from the village. Walked like he'd walked that path before.

lines.speaker: neighbor_holt
lines.text: Your girl walked beside him. Quiet. Like she'd been told to.

lines.speaker: neighbor_holt
lines.text: Past the chapel. Into the trees. I didn't follow.

lines.speaker: neighbor_holt
lines.text: You sleep like the dead, child. I called out. Twice.

lines.speaker: neighbor_holt
lines.text: By the time I had my boots on, they were gone into the trees.

lines.speaker: neighbor_holt
lines.text: Past the chapel. North, where the pines crowd close.

lines.speaker: neighbor_holt
lines.text: Past the chapel. North, where the pines crowd close.

lines.speaker: neighbor_holt
lines.text: I was alone. It was dark. Forgive an old man his caution.
